product_overview: TheXuong Sport is a sports e-commerce platform where customers can browse products, manage carts, place orders, and participate in a loyalty program with points, vouchers, and tier benefits. Admin users can manage products, orders, users, vouchers, tiers, and business statistics.
core_goals: Browse and search the product catalog
View product details and add selected items to the cart or favorites
Manage cart contents and complete checkout
Track orders and cancel pending orders
Edit account profile and change password
Earn and redeem loyalty points for vouchers
Manage products, orders, users, vouchers, and loyalty tiers as an admin

features.name: Product Browsing and Search
features.description: Customers can explore the product catalog, narrow results with filters, and sort or search for items they want to buy.
user_flows: Navigate to /products -> View the product grid -> Enter a keyword -> Select a sport filter -> Select a brand filter -> Choose a sort option -> See updated results
Navigate to /products -> View the product grid -> Click a product card -> See the product detail page

features.name: Product Detail View
features.description: Customers can review product information, choose a size variant, add the item to cart, or save it to favorites.
user_flows: Navigate to /product-detail/:id -> View product images and description -> Select an available size variant -> Add the item to cart -> See confirmation feedback
Navigate to /product-detail/:id -> View product images and description -> Toggle the favorite state -> See the product saved to favorites
Navigate to /product-detail/:id -> View product reviews and ratings

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Customers and guests can review cart items, adjust quantities, remove items, and proceed to checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /cart -> View cart items and subtotal -> Increase or decrease an item quantity -> See the cart total update
Navigate to /cart -> View cart items and subtotal -> Remove an item from the cart -> See the item disappear from the list
Navigate to /cart -> View cart items and subtotal -> Proceed to checkout

features.name: Checkout and Payment
features.description: Authenticated customers can enter shipping information, apply a voucher, place an order, and continue to the external VNPay payment flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout -> Fill shipping full name -> Fill shipping phone number -> Fill shipping address -> Apply a voucher code -> Place the order -> Redirect to VNPay payment flow
Navigate to /checkout -> Fill shipping full name -> Fill shipping phone number -> Fill shipping address -> Place the order -> Redirect to VNPay payment flow

features.name: User Login
features.description: Guests can sign in with email and password, access account features, or navigate to related account recovery and registration pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email -> Fill password -> Submit the login form -> See the account area
Navigate to /login -> Toggle password visibility -> Review the password entry
Navigate to /login -> Click the forgot password link -> Navigate to /forgot-password
Navigate to /login -> Click the registration link -> Navigate to /register

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Guests can create a new customer account using their name, email, and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill full name -> Fill email -> Fill password -> Fill confirm password -> Submit the registration form -> See redirect to login
Navigate to /register -> Submit the registration form with invalid input -> See validation errors

features.name: Forgot and Reset Password
features.description: Guests can request a password reset and complete the reset using a valid token.
user_flows: Navigate to /forgot-password -> Fill email -> Request a reset link -> See confirmation feedback
Navigate to /reset-password -> Fill new password -> Fill confirm password -> Submit the reset form -> See completion feedback

features.name: Order History and Detail
features.description: Signed-in customers can review their past orders, inspect order details, and cancel orders that are still pending.
user_flows: Navigate to /orders -> View the past order list with status indicators -> Open an order -> See order details
Navigate to /order/:id -> View order details -> Cancel a pending order -> See the order status update

features.name: User Profile Management
features.description: Signed-in customers can view and update personal information and change their password.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> View current profile information -> Edit full name -> Edit phone number -> Edit address -> Save the profile -> See updated information
Navigate to /profile -> Fill current password -> Fill new password -> Save the password change -> See completion feedback

features.name: Loyalty Rewards and Voucher Redemption
features.description: Signed-in customers can view points, history, owned vouchers, browse redeemable voucher options, and exchange points for vouchers.
user_flows: Navigate to /my-rewards -> View current points balance -> View points transaction history -> View owned vouchers -> Browse the voucher catalog
Navigate to /my-rewards -> Browse the voucher catalog -> Redeem a voucher -> See the owned voucher added to the account

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Admins can search, create, update, deactivate, and remove products, including uploading images and configuring variants.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/products -> View the product list -> Search for a product -> Open the create product flow -> Fill product fields -> Upload images -> Configure size quantities -> Save the product -> See the new product in the list
Navigate to /admin/products -> Open an existing product for editing -> Update product fields -> Save the changes -> See the updated product in the list
Navigate to /admin/products -> Select a product -> Toggle its active state -> See the status change
Navigate to /admin/products -> Select a product -> Delete the product -> See the product removed from the list

features.name: Admin Order Management
features.description: Admins can review all orders, filter and search them, and update order status.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/orders -> View the order list -> Filter by status -> Search by keyword -> See the list update
Navigate to /admin/orders -> Select an order -> Choose a new status -> Update the status -> See the order status change

features.name: Admin User Management
features.description: Admins can review users, toggle user activity, update roles, and create new users.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/users -> View the user list -> Toggle a user's active state -> See the account status change
Navigate to /admin/users -> View the user list -> Select a role for a user -> Save the role change -> See the updated role
Navigate to /admin/users -> Open the create user flow -> Fill the user form -> Create the account -> See the new user in the list

features.name: Admin Statistics Dashboard
features.description: Admins can view revenue, order, and product metrics on a statistics dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/statistics -> View statistic cards -> View charts and metrics -> Review revenue and order trends

features.name: Admin Voucher Management
features.description: Admins can search, filter, create, edit, delete, and bulk-manage voucher catalog entries, including VIP-only and status-based voucher rules.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/loyalty/vouchers -> View the voucher list -> Search by voucher code -> Filter by status -> Filter by VIP-only flag -> Filter by discount range -> See the list update

Navigate to /admin/loyalty/vouchers -> Open the create voucher flow -> Fill code or generate a code -> Fill discount amount -> Fill required points -> Fill minimum order amount -> Set VIP-only and status values -> Set expiry and applicability rules -> Save the voucher -> See the voucher appear in the table
Navigate to /admin/loyalty/vouchers -> Select an existing voucher -> Edit its details -> Save the changes -> See the updated voucher in the list
Navigate to /admin/loyalty/vouchers -> Select one or more vouchers -> Lock the selected vouchers -> See their statuses change
Navigate to /admin/loyalty/vouchers -> Select one or more vouchers -> Unlock the selected vouchers -> See their statuses change
Navigate to /admin/loyalty/vouchers -> Select one or more vouchers -> Delete the selected vouchers -> See the selected vouchers removed or marked expired
Navigate to /admin/loyalty/vouchers -> Select one or more vouchers -> Set VIP-only on the selected vouchers -> See the VIP flag update
Navigate to /admin/loyalty/vouchers -> View voucher statistics -> See summary metrics

features.name: Admin Tier Management
features.description: Admins can manage loyalty tiers, adjust points, update user tiers, and inspect loyalty progress and history.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/loyalty/tiers -> View the tier list -> Review thresholds and benefits -> See loyalty tier configuration
Navigate to /admin/loyalty/tiers -> Create a new tier -> Fill tier code, name, minimum spend, and minimum points -> Save the tier -> See the new tier in the list
Navigate to /admin/loyalty/tiers -> Edit a tier -> Update tier details -> Save the changes -> See the updated tier
Navigate to /admin/loyalty/tiers -> Delete a tier -> See the tier removed from the list
Navigate to /admin/loyalty/tiers -> Open a user loyalty progress view -> Review progress and tier history -> See the user's loyalty record
Navigate to /admin/loyalty/tiers -> Open a user point adjustment flow -> Add points with a note -> Save the adjustment -> See the updated balance
Navigate to /admin/loyalty/tiers -> Open a user tier update flow -> Choose a new tier -> Add a reason -> Save the update -> See the user's tier change

known_limitations.issue: Google OAuth2 login requires external redirect to Google consent screen which cannot be completed in automated headless testing
known_limitations.impact: Only email/password JWT login can be tested automatically, OAuth2 flow must be tested manually

known_limitations.issue: VNPay payment redirects to external payment gateway URL which cannot be completed in automated testing
known_limitations.impact: Order placement can be initiated but payment confirmation cannot be verified automatically

known_limitations.issue: Authentication uses session cookie (JSESSIONID) with CSRF token requiring withCredentials and X-CSRF-TOKEN header
known_limitations.impact: Test framework must preserve cookies across requests and handle CSRF token for mutating operations

known_limitations.issue: Admin-only routes redirect pure admin users away from customer pages and vice versa
known_limitations.impact: Test must use appropriate role credentials (ADMIN vs CUSTOMER) for each route under test
